title: fix view schema override for object view

goal.text: fix view schema override for object view

requirements.summary: 修复 view schema override 只在 array 视图生效、object 详情视图不生效的问题。
acceptanceCriteria: 在 schema-authoring demo 中，开启 View 后编辑 object/detail 视图的字段 schema 会写入 view file，并与 default 隔离。
View 对 array/table 视图和 object/detail 视图都使用同一个 resolved schema layer。
初始 view file 为空时，object 与 array 视图都不应和 default 有差异。
新增或更新 focused tests，并通过相关 Vitest 与 build:app。

tasks.title: Refine requirements and test scope
tasks.detail: Capture the object-view override regression and expected behavior for view/default isolation.

tasks.title: Enter process.active
tasks.detail: Move the claw plan into active execution and start goal tracking.

tasks.title: Reproduce object-view override gap
tasks.detail: Inspect object/detail schema reads and writes, compare them with array/table schema behavior, and add a focused failing test if needed.

tasks.title: Implement object-view schema layer fix
tasks.detail: Patch the narrow root cause so object/detail pages use active view schema for reads and directed writes.

tasks.title: Verify regression coverage
tasks.detail: Run focused schema-authoring tests and npm run build:app, then close out the claw plan.

keyDecisions: Object/detail page 已能读取 active view resolved schema；本次修复不改变底层 overlay 规则。
Object/detail page 的 schema authoring 入口需要与 array/table page 对齐：Edit 模式下允许编辑字段 title，并通过 onUpdateDocumentSchema 写入当前 active layer。
字段 title 为空时删除 title，回退到字段 key，避免制造空标题覆盖。

retrospective.summary: 修复了 view 在 object 详情页看起来不生效的问题：根因不是 overlay 读取失败，而是 object 页缺少可见的字段标题 schema 编辑入口。现在 Edit 模式下可编辑 object 字段标题，View 模式写入 view file 并与 default 隔离；相关 focused tests 与 build:app 已通过。
